newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ easing warranted but now overdone, says Brash.
newsitem.headline: NZ easing warranted but now overdone, says Brash.

text.p: Reserve Bank Governor Don Brash said on Tuesday that some easing in New Zealand monetary policy had been warranted but that recent market reaction was "somewhat excessive".
He said the bank's new 0-3 percent inflation target meant that monetary conditions would be easier than might otherwise have been the case.
"On balance, it is the bank's judgement that some easing in monetary conditions compared with those assumed in the Monetary Policy is indeed appropriate," Brash told reporters.
